item.title: Blocked gulley, 26th August
item.description:
This drain has had vegetation growing in it for a while. It's one of many in the area which WILL cause flooding when the expected torrential rain arrives. I can see a green marker has been sprayed on the kerb but that's not necessarily for the blocked drain. Would you like me to take photos of all the blocked drains in Maiden Lane and surrounding areas? It's not a Thames water issue - it's the rubbish accumulating on the roadside. We really do need to bring back the street cleaners. The rubbish is having a knock on effect with drains and a fire risk...

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): White Hill Road, Barnes Cray, Greater London
